data.one_liner: Easy async task cancellation for tasks using cancellation tokens in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides CancellationToken utilities to cancel futures, isolates, completers, and custom async operations. It allows cleaning up resources and propagating cancellation exceptions across tasks.
use_when: You need to cancel pending Futures or Isolates when a widget is disposed.
You want to share a single CancellationToken across multiple async tasks.
avoid_when: You only need HTTP request cancellation and can use a dedicated HTTP client package instead.
strengths: Supports futures, completers, isolates, and custom cancellables.
Helps prevent memory leaks and unneeded processing when widgets dispose.
weaknesses: Requires manual plumbing or specific wrapper classes for existing async functions.
